# f5xc_shape_bot_defense_instance (Data Source)

Shape Bot Defense Instance is the main configuration for a Shape Integration.<br>It defines various configuration parameters needed to use Shape SSEs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Shape Bot Defense Instance - Full

data "f5xc_shape_bot_defense_instance" "example" {
  name      = "default"
  namespace = "default"
}
```

- `namespace` (String) namespace This defines the workspace within which each the configuration object is to be created. Must be a DNS_LABEL format. For a namespace object itself, namespace value will be ''
